name: Obadiah
description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom. We are going to find out about Edom.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

points: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen. And the ambassador is sent among the heathen. That is the other part of the rumour. But I am dealing with the rumour where we are bringing out the truth about him. And that is what is bothering these preachers. That is what is bothering Esau mainly, and it is bothering his minions, the black preachers that serve Esau, that serve Christianity.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

points: The vision of Obadiah, concerning Edom. Remember what we just read in Psalms 137: the daughter of Babylon is the children of Edom. An ambassador is sent among the heathen: somebody rises up among the nations and says, arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle. The nations go against America and her allies.
The vision of Obadiah: thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom. Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised. That is the title of this class.

The vision of Obadiah: thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom. We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen: Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle. That is why the nations of the earth are aligning against the United States of America.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

points: The vision of Obadiah, concerning Edom: E D O M, which means red, the red people. An ambassador is sent among the heathen: we are seeing ambassadors pop up trying to organize and rally the nations against America, but nobody has fit the bill as of yet. Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle: this is going to happen.
The vision of Obadiah, and it is spoken concerning Edom: Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
